title: Bioinformatic investigation of convergent proteins and cellular functions downstream of autism-associated genes
title_zh: 自闭症相关基因下游收敛蛋白与细胞功能的生物信息学调查
abstract: Abstract Autism spectrum disorder affects 1 in 31 people yet exhibits remarkable genetic heterogeneity with over 1000 genes identified in autistic populations producing convergent neurobiological phenotypes through not yet understood mechanisms. Here, we employed systems-level network analysis to test if diverse autism risk genes converge onto common cellular vulnerabilities across brain cell types. Using 1238 autism-associated genes from the Simons Foundation Autism Research Initiative (SFARI) database, we stratified genes by cell-type-specific expression patterns and constructed protein-protein interaction networks to map functional clusters and identify critical connector proteins. Through permutation-based statistical analysis, we identified convergent downstream proteins targets, representing molecular vulnerabilities where multiple autism-associated protein pathways converge for miscoordination of cellular function. Network analysis revealed cell-type-specific vulnerability signatures: SYN1 in inhibitory neurons, GRIN/DLG/CAMK2 proteins in excitatory neurons, GRIA2A/DLG4/GRIN2 in oligodendrocyte precursor cells, ACTL6B in oligodendrocytes, and ARHGAP/DOCK proteins in astrocytes. Remarkably, these computationally predicted targets have been independently validated in human genetics and autism research, demonstrating that network-based convergent vulnerability analysis successfully identifies critical nodes where diverse genetic insults disrupt coordinated cellular responses. This framework provides a molecular basis for understanding autism pathophysiology and identifies promising targets for intervention in the treatment of neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自闭症谱系障碍影响1/31人，却表现出显著的遗传异质性，在自闭症人群中已鉴定出1000多个基因，通过尚未完全阐明的机制产生收敛的神经生物学表型。在此，我们利用系统级网络分析，测试不同自闭症风险基因是否在脑细胞类型中收敛于共同的细胞易感性。利用西蒙斯基金会自闭症研究倡议(SFARI)数据库中的1238个自闭症相关基因，我们按细胞类型特异性表达模式对基因进行分层，构建蛋白-蛋白相互作用网络以映射功能聚类并识别关键连接蛋白。通过基于置换的统计分析，我们鉴定出收敛的下游蛋白靶点，这些靶点代表了多个自闭症相关蛋白途径汇聚的分子易感性，从而导致细胞功能错协。网络分析揭示了细胞类型特异性易感性特征：抑制性神经元中的SYN1，兴奋性神经元中的GRIN/DLG/CAMK2蛋白，星形胶质细胞前体细胞中的GRIA2A/DLG4/GRIN2，星形胶质细胞中的ACTL6B，以及星形胶质细胞中的ARHGAP/DOCK蛋白。值得注意的是，这些计算预测的靶点已在人类遗传学和自闭症研究中得到独立验证，这表明基于网络的收敛易感性分析成功识别出多种基因损伤扰协调细胞反应的关键节点。该框架为理解自闭症病理生理学提供了分子基础，并鉴定出治疗神经发育障碍的有前景的靶点。
